profile.headline: Eng II - Software Development
profile.summary: Experienced data heavy operations professional. My ability to adapt has allowed me to thrive in many environments including living abroad, assimilating comfortably into a culture very different than my own. I welcome new challenges and new adventures.

positions.title: Jr Full Stack Java Developer Apprentice
Part-time Ramp Supervisor
positions.description:
•   Supervised 18-30 employees unloading air containers for high priority same-day delivery line.
•   Oversaw the loading process for 16 delivery routes. Each route had up to 300pkgs/day.
•   Improved communication with other departments by updating forms for readability and relevance.
•   Assisted in training and development of over 60 new employees in 3 months.
•   Monitored safety of equipment, work areas, and employee work habits.
•   Improved morale of my team by listening to their concerns and helping them to develop routines suited to their strengths and individual needs. 
•   Worked collaboratively with the EAM Supervisor to improve the efficiency and performance of my team by developing strategies to reduce errors and increase load speeds.

positions.title: Air Ramp Agent
positions.description:
•   Delivered over 100 cargo containers between sorting facility and aircraft per day.
•   Coordinated with my team to ensure the sorting facility had appropriate size containers for up to 20 flights per day.
•   Used radio and hand signals to communicate with ground crews.
•   Verified destination and safety labels on up to 300 packages/day to be loaded onto small aircraft by hand.

positions.title: Rural Carrier Associate
positions.description:
•   Sorted and sequenced mail by hand for multiple routes with up to 900 stops each.
•   Accurately delivered up to 100parcels per day to doorsteps while tracking the delivery with a mobile scanning device.
•   Delivered up to 10 high-priority express packages in as little as 30 minutes by planning the most efficient delivery sequence.
•   Adapted to deliver in extreme temperatures from 30°F to 115°F.

volunteerExperiences.description: I provided information about Islam to non-Muslims in the wake of the 9/11 attacks. Assisted with arranging guest speakers at schools and businesses. Provided administrative services, such as answering phones, filing documents, creating custom publications using standard office equipment and software. Proactively bridged the gap of understanding between non-Muslims, Muslims, and members of the Nation of Islam to promote acceptance, tolerance, and understanding within the community.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Helena Hatch Special Care Center - Saint Louis, MO
volunteerExperiences.description: Helena Hatch SCCW was a full-service clinic serving underprivileged women infected or affected by HIV/AIDS. I welcomed women arriving for clinic appointments helping them to feel comfortable and safe. I would help them get their children situated into the onsite daycare for clients and notify their case manager of their arrival. I would also secure a snack and a drink for the client and chat with them about their day. This helped to identify needs that I would then communicate to their caseworkers so they were better prepared with help for them after their clinic appointment was complete.

company.name: Helena Hatch Special Care Center - Saint Louis, MO
